products.name: Enablement Kit — Multi-Factor Authentication & Conditional Access — Commercial
products.short_description: Level up your team on MFA & Conditional Access — a self-guided enablement kit with concepts, design patterns, and hands-on labs (report-only first).
products.description:
Level up your team on MFA & Conditional Access — a self-guided enablement kit with concepts, design patterns, and hands-on labs (report-only first).

MFA and Conditional Access are the front line, but misconfigured they lock users out or leave gaps. This enablement kit teaches MFA and Conditional Access on Microsoft Entra — methods (incl. phishing-resistant), CA design patterns and personas, report-only testing, and troubleshooting — with guided labs your team runs safely in report-only mode.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • MFA methods concepts (incl. phishing-resistant) and registration
  • Conditional Access design patterns, personas, and common policies
  • Report-only + What-If testing labs (no lockouts) and break-glass
  • Troubleshooting sign-in failures and CA evaluation
  • Take-home runbook and knowledge-check

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A team that designs, tests, and troubleshoots MFA and Conditional Access safely — confident policies, no lockouts.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EKMFACA-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of MFA methods and Conditional Access
    • EKMFACA-LabPolicy.ps1 — create the REPORT-ONLY CA lab policies (persona-scoped, break-glass excluded)
    • EKMFACA-Report.ps1 — report-only CA impact + cohort progress for the enablement kit (read-only)
    • EKMFACA-Validate.ps1 — run the kit pass/fail gates and print the knowledge-check (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
